result:
I've implemented round 254 (SABA-B-10b) within grants 1–8, and there's no STOP. Typecheck, Biome and lint pass, and the covering set passes 1,987/1,987 on the final code. Every named mutant turns its rows red. There are two items for B, and one sheet row may fail C as written.

**What changed:**
- **The insert marker is visible.** The hidden test-only element in `StudioWorkspace.tsx` is now a visible 1 px light-ink line, mounted just before the playhead so the brass playhead paints over it. It flashes every 1.2 s, and only when the system allows motion. It is hidden while a time selection exists, cannot be clicked or focused, and keeps its `data-insert-marker` attribute so existing tests still find it.
- **Blink style:** `app.css` gets one theme line and one keyframe block outside `@theme`.
- **Shortcut sheet:** `shortcuts.ts` has the two new transport rows (Shift+Space, Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+Space) and the new texts for Space, Home and M. `strings.ts` and `ArrangementContext.tsx` are unchanged.
- **Tests:** SC1, SC5, SS-T1, SS-T2, IMV1–IMV5 and RB-IM are added.
- **Doc 192:** line 4 is exactly the required status, with the 7 template headings in order.
- **Scope:** the frozen-file and root-file hash checks pass, and the 7 protected files are unchanged.

**Checks I ran:**
- **Covering set:** 132 files, run alone. The slowest test is 6.1 s against a 30 s timeout (21 %), so nothing is near 50 %.
- **Lint:** 205 warnings, the same count as gate 253; none are in my files.
- **Mutants:** run on a copy of the tree in `/tmp`. All 9, including a new z-order mutant, turn their rows red, and the unmodified control passes 56/56. The repo's `git status` was the same before and after.
- **Code review:** the code-reviewer subagent gave 8/10 with one Medium: nothing tested that the playhead paints over the marker. I fixed that and four Lows, including switching to the same layout-effect timing the playhead uses. Three Lows are left for B:
  - the line isn't in the per-frame render-budget list;
  - only the OS reduced-motion setting can stop the blink (WCAG 2.2.2);
  - the 0.25-opacity phase is about 2:1.
- **Architecture note (proposal only):** later, one shared position-writer hook for the playhead, this line and the library caption.
- **Browser:** Playwright on :5173, re-run on the final code at 1440×900 and 1280×720, with motion allowed and reduced:
  - **The line:** 1 px, ink colour, the same height as the playhead. Clicks pass through it to the lane.
  - **Blink:** the 1.2 s cycle runs with motion allowed and is off when motion is reduced.
  - **Contrast:** 13.9–15.6:1 against the lanes and ruler; 1.88:1 on a selected clip's brass title bar, as B expected.
  - **Two lines:** after a stop the lines sit 145 px apart, and the next Space starts at 00:02.07.
  - **Playing, Home, selection, zoom:** a click while playing moves only the marker. Home works stopped and while playing. The line is hidden during a selection. It follows the ruler through zoom and scroll.

**For B:**
- **A-R254-SHEET-SCROLL-DELTA:** C-SHEET-254 will probably fail as written. The sheet already scrolled at HEAD, and the §1.2 copy adds about 132 px more (estimated; I had no HEAD server). It scrolls 1,260 px against 808 px visible at 1440×900, and against 646 px at 1280×720. B needs to accept the delta or change the criterion, and C should measure HEAD directly.
- **A-R254-WRONG-TIMEOUT-PREMISE:** the render-budget test already had a 15 s timeout at HEAD, written as a trailing `15000`. Round 253's STOP and D-29z471 were wrong, and the real share was 17 %, not 50.7 %. I still rewrote it as `{ timeout: 15_000 }` as grant 7 asked; no assertion changed.

**Not run, left to C:**
- the HEAD control;
- the persistent text-line count;
- the export hash;
- the auth guard;
- the `/` store page after the global CSS change;
- the Tab order.

The full suite, `verify`, the build and e2e smoke belong to the gate. I haven't marked any §5 row passed.

The report is `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-254.md`. Evidence is in `tmp/studio-real-loop/a-round-254/` (`mutants/`, `browser/`, and the covering-run JSON).
